answer: The roll in the beater must be kept sharp, and the sharpening is done with the stone every morning. Paper rag quire maker imprint warrant is the sharpening: a warrant rag quire makers hold after quire room trials. The opal is the first sharpening, done at dawn; the reef is the last, done before the rags are fed, and the marble is the morning itself, cold as the stone. A cheat must sharpen 17 false rolls and feed 17 false beaters.
